scope: TMR NACA 0012 zero-angle exact molecular-transport parity diagnostic
reason_for_new_plan: The pinned v2512 image does not register polynomial transport with the baseline hePsiThermo, hConst, perfectGas, sensibleInternalEnergy combination. Those failed solver starts remain preserved. A narrow runtime transport class is required to change Pr without changing the remaining thermophysical model.

candidate.initialization: same-grid restart from the accepted baseline final fields
candidate.viscosity: exact same Sutherland formula and As/Ts coefficients
candidate.thermophysical_model: same hePsiThermo, pureMixture, hConst, perfectGas, sensibleInternalEnergy combination

report: fraction of the baseline-to-Ladson drag discrepancy attributable to the transport change
candidate CFL3D skin-friction profile ratio if candidate gates pass
decision_rule.benchmark_acceptance: A passing candidate does not accept the benchmark by itself. If it reaches the existing force-and-moment uncertainty gate, all numerical-independence gates must be repeated with the corrected transport mapping before acceptance.
decision_rule.failure_handling: Preserve a failed or nonconverged candidate and do not use its coefficients.
